name: Emberwatch
description: A dim red dwarf system on the arm's cold fringe, easily missed by passing survey sweeps. Its flare-prone sun sculpts the inner worlds into rusted relics, while the outer ice keeps secrets beneath kilometers of shell. Salvors whisper about lights moving under that ice.

stars.name: Ashen Meridian
stars.description: A dim crimson flicker of a star, prone to sudden flares that bathe its worlds in hard radiation and aurora. Between outbursts it burns with a patience measured in trillions of years, watching its small retinue like a lighthouse keeper.

planets.name: Rustfall
planets.description: An iron-red desert world stripped thin by flare winds, its dune belts singing with static. Canyon walls preserve the layer record of a billion storms, and prospectors dig there for metals the star never bothered to swallow.

planets.name: The Pale Shallows
planets.description: A frozen world whose kilometer-deep ice shell glows faint blue over a liquid sea kept warm by tidal kneading. Cryovolcanic plumes feed a wispy ring of snow that never settles. Something down there answers sonar pings with slower, older rhythms.
